title: Coloring powers of random graphs
summary: Given a graph $G$ and an integer $r\ge 1$, the $r$th power $G^r$ of $G$ is the graph obtained from $G$ by adding edges for all pairs of distinct vertices at distance at most $r$ from each other. We focus on two basic structural properties of the $r$th power of the binomial random graph $G_{n,p}$, namely, the maximum degree $Δ(G_{n,p}^r)$ and the chromatic number $χ(G_{n,p}^r)$, and give with high probability (w.h.p.) bounds.
